title: hemizonia cephalotes
intro: Hemizonia cephalotes, commonly known as Tansyaster or California Tarweed, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Hemizonia cephalotes include its use as a treatment for respiratory issues, skin conditions, and gastrointestinal problems, due to its bioactive constituents which include sesquiterpene lactones and other compounds. Research on the plant's bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, has shown potential for further investigation into its medicinal properties.
